description: A new subtitle profile. Fields you leave out take the defaults of Studio.

languages.description: Languages the profile is meant for; empty or null means every language.

active.description: Whether the profile can be applied to projects.

minDuration.description: Minimum duration of a subtitle in seconds.

maxDuration.description: Maximum duration of a subtitle in seconds.

maxLineCharacterCount.description: Maximum number of characters on a line.

maxGapBetweenWords.description: Longest pause between two words that still stay in one subtitle, in seconds.

minGapFrames.description: Minimum gap between two subtitles in frames.

subtitlePosition.description: Where subtitles are placed on the video.

displaySpeakerNames.description: Whether the speaker name is shown in front of the text.

maxLinesPerScreen.description: Maximum number of lines shown at the same time.

charactersPerSecond.description: Maximum reading speed in characters per second.

fontFamily.description: Font family: a name such as `Arial`, or `custom:<id>` for a custom font (the `fontFamily` value of `GET /v1/fonts`). A custom font that was deleted falls back to Arial in burned-in video.

textColor.description: Text color as a CSS color.

backgroundType.description: How the text is separated from the video.

backgroundColor.description: Background color as a CSS color.

verticalPositioning.description: Whether subtitles are positioned vertically from the edge instead of by the placement setting.

layout.description: Video layout the profile is made for.
